data.summary: AGV-3 is the least reliable AGV, showing the highest 90-day fault count, the most aborted and late tasks in shift A, and the dominant incident and telemetry fault records concentrated in shift A during August to October 2026.

findings.claim: AGV-3 is the least reliable AGV with 84 faults in the last 90 days, far above the next highest AGV-6 at 25 faults.
AGV-3 in shift A recorded 86 aborted tasks and 313 late tasks, the highest failure counts among all AGV/shift combinations.
AGV-3 shift A incidents are concentrated from July through October 2026, including 9 incidents on 2026-08-17 and 6 incidents on 2026-10-12.
AGV-3 telemetry fault events spike in October 2026, with 49 E52_NAV_LOST events on 2026-10-14 and 46 E40_BATTERY_LOW events on 2026-10-12.

data.recommendation: Take AGV-3 out of shift A service immediately and schedule a full inspection focusing on battery and navigation faults before returning it to production.
